data.one_liner: Low‑level tools for reading and writing JSON without creating intermediate Dart objects
data.what_it_does: Provides JsonReader, JsonSink, JsonBuilder and JsonProcessor classes that operate directly on JSON strings, bytes or Dart structures. It allows pull‑based parsing, push‑based building and composable transformations.
use_when: You need fast, memory‑efficient JSON processing in a performance‑critical part of your app
You want to avoid allocating intermediate List or Map objects when parsing large JSON payloads
avoid_when: You need code‑generation for JSON models
You prefer a higher‑level, auto‑generated API like json_serializable
strengths: Supports both pull and push APIs
weaknesses: Requires manual handling of JSON structure
Limited documentation on advanced use cases
